ResearchProjectDef.label: replicator study
ResearchProjectDef.description: Study recovered Replicator blocks, control lattices and their modular reassembly logic.

ResearchProjectDef.label: controlled replicator gestation
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop a colony-safe gestation process for the Child's Toy, a controlled mech built from Replicator substrate whose lattice can still become a normal Drone if it goes feral.

ResearchProjectDef.label: nanite containment
ResearchProjectDef.description: Develop practical containment and EMP procedures for dangerous Replicator bodies, salvage and self-assembling matter.
